content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Casey Moss?
No, this is Casey's spouse; Casey can't come to the phone right now. Is there something I can help with?
I can only discuss this with Mx Moss alone. When would be a good time to reach them?
That's fine, I understand. Casey will be available tomorrow at ten in the morning, so that would be a good time to call back.
Thank you, your callback is booked. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
